description: This file defines the 'EmailMarketing' class which manages email marketing campaigns within SuiteCRM. It includes properties for campaign data, methods for saving, retrieving, validation, and generating views, as well as internal logic for handling prospect lists related to campaigns.

classes.name: EmailMarketing
classes.description: Represents an email marketing campaign with properties for campaign details and methods for data management, validation, and view logic.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Prepares date and time, applies timezone adjustments, and saves the campaign data.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Loads campaign data by ID and separates date and time components.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the campaign's name as summary.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Creates SQL query to export campaign list data.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Generates array of data for list view, including prospect list names and optional campaign links.

methods.name: isCampaignDetailView
methods.description: Checks if current request is for campaign detail view.

methods.name: makeCampaignWizardEditLink
methods.description: Wraps campaign and template names with HTML links for editing.

methods.name: get_all_prospect_lists
methods.description: Constructs SQL to retrieve prospect lists associated with the campaign.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates required campaign fields and returns errors if any.
